message:
We all have that one friend who tends to panic at the first sign of trouble, right? 😅 But when it comes to preparedness, a little planning can go a long way in helping us all feel more at ease. This resource is a fantastic guide to help us create our own emergency plans together, ensuring we know what to do when life throws us a curveball. 

Let’s take a moment to think about our own families and communities — what steps can we take today to feel a bit more secure tomorrow? 🌼
